fixes.what: Change align-content:center to align-content:start with padding-top:clamp(40px,6vh,72px), and drop the min-height to calc(var(--vh100) - var(--header-h) - 420 * var(--s)); then trim .screen--celebrations and .screen--inquire padding-top to clamp(72px,10vh,120px).
fixes.why: At 1440×900 the desktop-1 shot shows ~200px of empty night under the canopy and a lone 'Reimagined Heritage' at the fold with the kashida, statement and promises below it; the block should arrive together under the fruit, and the 250px voids before 'The celebrations' and 'Tell us about your family' make the mid-page feel like trunks with nothing in them.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css: .form (background:rgba(18,23,20,.55); border-top:2px solid var(--gold)) as used on index.html screen 4
fixes.what: On .canopy .form remove the panel fill (background:transparent) and keep the gold top rule plus the field fills, or keep the fill and add -webkit-mask-image/mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 70%,transparent) so the box has no square bottom edge over the roots.
fixes.why: Desktop-3/4 and phone-4 show a hard-edged translucent rectangle sitting on the painted roots; it reads as a UI card, the one boxy shape on an otherwise organic page.

fixes.what: Add filter:saturate(.75) brightness(.85) hue-rotate(-8deg) (or recut the 70px sprite from the ground's own painted fruit) so it matches the ruby of the two big pomegranates.
fixes.why: In desktop-4 and phone-4 the rolled fruit is a flat magenta disc beside crimson painted fruit; it looks pasted on, not part of the painting.

fixes.what: Set --tree-w:110vw and --gutter:40px (same content width, ~35px of bark per side instead of ~21px), and re-check the hero canopy width at 390px.
fixes.why: Phone-1 to phone-3 show the trunks as two thin brown stripes that read as a page border, not a tree; the frame should be recognisably bark.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css: .site-nav a and .nav-phone (header over the hero video on index, before .is-scrolled)
fixes.what: Add text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(27,34,30,.9) to .page-index .site-header:not(.is-scrolled) .site-nav a, .nav-phone, and the same to .hero__line's rule (already there) so the header matches.
fixes.why: Desktop-0 shows the nav links over white tent drapery with no shadow; a brighter frame of the loop will wash them out while every other hero line already carries the night shadow.

fixes.where: index.html screen 3: .cel figure (three stand-in slots) and assets/css/canopy.css .cel
fixes.what: Give the three figcaptions a fixed 2-line min-height for the description (min-height:48px) and add a 2px gold short rule (24px) above each h3 in the promises' style.
fixes.why: Desktop-3 shows the three captions ending at different heights; the slot row is the one place the home page shows product, and it should sit as a single ruled band like the promises above it.
